title: Blink
summary: Make the built-in LED blink once per second.
goal: The LED on pin 13 turns on for 500 ms, then off for 500 ms, forever.
brief:
Every microcontroller journey starts with a blinking LED. The Arduino Uno has an LED wired to **digital pin 13**.

1. In `setup()`, make pin 13 an output with `pinMode`.
2. In `loop()`, switch it on with `digitalWrite(13, HIGH)`, wait 500 ms with `delay`, switch it off, wait again.

`loop()` runs over and over, so the LED keeps blinking.
hints: A pin is an input by default. Which function turns it into an output?
pinMode(13, OUTPUT); goes in setup(). In loop() you need four lines: on, wait, off, wait.
digitalWrite(13, HIGH); delay(500); digitalWrite(13, LOW); delay(500);
